name: inworld
description: Official Inworld AI plugin for Codex — the top-rated TTS-2 model with natural-language steering across 200+ languages, hundreds of professional voices plus instant voice cloning & design, STT with voice profiling (age, emotion, accent), Realtime voice agents, and the LLM Router.

interface.shortDescription: Add realtime voice to your app: TTS, STT, voice agents
interface.longDescription: Wire Inworld's speech APIs into any project. Scaffold TTS-2 and TTS-2 Flash (200+ languages, natural-language steering, sub-100 ms streaming), batch and streaming STT, Realtime speech-to-speech voice agents, and the OpenAI-compatible LLM Router. Clone or design voices, migrate an existing ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Cartesia, or Deepgram integration, and search Inworld's docs from chat.
defaultPrompt: Add Inworld text-to-speech to this project
Migrate this app's TTS from ElevenLabs to Inworld
Build a realtime voice agent with Inworld
Find me a calm, warm voice for this app and let me hear it
